context: Two elders reminisce about old shrine traditions
purpose: Teach: 霊/参拝/イスラム/権威/闘争/数々/増大/養成

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 佐知子さん、昔の神社参拝の習わしを覚えておるかね。数々の祭りで賑わったものだ。
lines.en: Sachiko, do you remember the old shrine visit customs? Countless festivals used to liven up this place.
lines.style: Nostalgic and warm, slow elderly male voice reminiscing fondly

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、覚えていますよ。早朝に氏神様へ参拝して、神主さんから霊験あらたかなお札をいただいたわね。
lines.en: Yes, I remember. We visited the tutelary shrine at dawn, and received spiritually potent talismans from the priest.
lines.style: Soft elderly female voice, gentle and reflective with reverent tone

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: あの頃の神職には本物の権威があってな。今は跡継ぎの養成すら難しい時代になってしまった。
lines.en: Back then, Shinto priests carried real authority. These days, even training successors has become difficult.
lines.style: Slightly sorrowful elderly male tone, quietly disappointed but dignified

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 本当ねえ。檀家同士の派閥闘争まであって、若い人たちが離れていったのも無理ないわ。
lines.en: Truly. There were even faction struggles among parishioners, so it's no wonder young people drifted away.
lines.style: Gentle elderly female voice, sighing softly with quiet resignation

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫がな、大学でイスラム教やキリスト教を学んでおるそうだ。世界の宗教への関心が増大しとるらしい。
lines.en: My grandson is studying Islam and Christianity at university. Apparently interest in world religions is growing.
lines.style: Curious elderly male tone, slightly impressed and contemplative

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: それも結構なことよ。でも自分の足元の神様も忘れないでほしいわねえ。
lines.en: That's a fine thing too. But I do hope they don't forget the gods right under their feet.
lines.style: Warm motherly elderly female voice, mildly wistful and hopeful

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: うむ。来月の例大祭、わしらも昔のように参拝しに行こうではないか。
lines.en: Indeed. Next month's grand festival — shall we go pay our respects together, the old way?
lines.style: Firm but kindly elderly male voice, inviting and resolute

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ええ、ぜひ。きっとご先祖様の霊も喜んでくださいますよ。
lines.en: Yes, by all means. I'm sure our ancestors' spirits will be pleased as well.
lines.style: Gentle elderly female voice, smiling softly with quiet conviction
